_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Neither breakout nor breakdown has cleared — stablecoin reserves build but ETF flows and funding have not confirmed conversion to spot demand, and extreme macro hedging keeps the coil intact.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both see a coil in Hope, but the analyst is explicitly HOLD/low conviction while the narrative writer leans toward imminent directional resolution without committing to a side.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows sustain above 85 AND funding climbs above 70 with VIX compression below 45, confirming Thrill-leg continuation to Optimism.
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC exchange reserves drop below 70th percentile with negative netflow AND VIX spikes above 75, forcing a revisit of Anxiety or Panic.
